candidates.title: 7 Montreal police officers dismissed over racist, discriminatory conduct
candidates.description: Montreal police Chief Fady Dagher has announced the administrative dismissal of seven employees in connection with allegations of discriminatory and racist behaviour, as well as derogatory acts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Former Alberta junior hockey executive charged with sex offences against players
candidates.description: Tyler King, 39, has been arrested and charged with sexually exploiting three players. The complainants, all under 18 at the time, were junior A players from Saskatchewan and Alberta.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Mining company slams decision for N.S. gold mine to undergo federal environmental impact assessment
candidates.description: A proposed gold mining megaproject that would span three sites on Nova Scotia’s Eastern Shore is poised to undergo a federal impact assessment — much to the chagrin of the company behind it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Privacy watchdog urges Senate to further amend Liberals' controversial lawful access bill
candidates.description: After facing searing criticism this spring, the Liberal government's hot-button lawful access legislation — which would make it easier for Canadian police and intelligence officials to tap private communications — now begins its time before a Senate committee.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta panel reveals new electoral maps as chair dismisses constitutional concerns
candidates.description: An advisory panel issued a report on Alberta’s electoral boundaries Monday, restoring rural ridings removed from the map by a prior commission while extending the boundaries of several Calgary ridings into surrounding rural communities.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Woman, 48, and boy, 12, arrested, Hamilton police say, after air cadet leader assaulted while selling poppies
candidates.description: The 59-year-old victim is a commanding officer and was supervising young cadets selling Remembrance Day poppies on Sunday. Police said the 12-year-old and another boy approached them and 'blew a loud air horn directly into [the young cadets'] ears' and an altercation ensued.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Members of Belleville, Ont., synagogue targeted by gunman call for more security funding
candidates.description: Members of the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville, Ont., are calling on the federal government to boost support for community safety programs, weeks after a hate-motivated shooting outside their place of worship.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.S. minor hockey player accused of sex assault pleads guilty to three charges
candidates.description: The second of two Nova Scotia minor hockey players accused of sexually assaulting teammates has pleaded guilty to three charges.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cockpit recorder of Hamilton-based air ambulance recovered after fatal crash off Massachusetts coast
candidates.description: The cockpit voice recorder of the Hamilton-based Latitude Air Ambulance that crashed in early October in the U.S., killing six people, has been recovered, the Transportation Safety Board of Canada said Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: TD tried to make grieving mom pay $38K in student debt after daughter died of cancer
candidates.description: When Joyel Singfield co-signed her daughter’s TD student loan in 2020, it included life insurance. But when Maari died last year of breast cancer, TD told Singfield the life insurance had expired and she was on the hook for the nearly $40,000 debt. Singfield fought back and, with the help of Go Public, TD backtracked and erased the entire debt.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nathan Fielder lookalike contest coming to Toronto this month
candidates.description: Nathan Fielder lookalikes will compete with mock business pitches and karaoke at Toronto’s Paradise Theatre on Nov. 17.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Seniors making $100K or less will get a cash payout in December: N.L. government
candidates.description: The rising cost of living is a burden for some seniors, but members of the Torbay 50-plus active group hope that a new cash payout from the Government of Newfoundland and Labrador will provide some relief.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Inside man or scapegoat? Defence, prosecutors make closing submissions in Pearson airport gold heist trial
candidates.description: Was a then-Air Canada employee an inside man who helped carry out one of the biggest gold heists in Canadian history, or a scapegoat exploited by a longtime friend? Those were the two competing scenarios presented to a Brampton, Ont., court Monday as prosecutors and defence lawyers made their closing submissions in the trial of Parmpal Sidhu.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How a Toronto rec basketball league became a million-dollar business
candidates.description: Brodie Rec League is a basketball league that launched in Burlington in 2020 and now has 50,000 athletes playing across 25 cities in North America including Burnaby, Toronto, Brooklyn, and Boston.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec man accused of threatening PM Mark Carney found not criminally responsible
candidates.description: A Quebec man accused of threatening Prime Minister Mark Carney over social media was declared not criminally responsible during a hearing Monday morning.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: ‘There’s been no failure,’ police chief says after Bridle Path home invasion suspect let go from hospital
candidates.description: Toronto police Chief Myron Demkiw assured residents "there's been no failure" in the investigation of a Bridle Path home invasion, after a man later deemed a suspect visited a hospital with a gunshot wound shortly after the incident Thursday but wasn't arrested.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'We often try suicide': The hidden cost of problem gambling in Canada
candidates.description: A CBC News investigation found at least 220 problem gamblers in Canada died by suicide in the last decade. But not all provinces are tracking this phenomenon, and no coroner has held a gambling suicide inquest — unlike in Australia and the U.K.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 20-year-old co-pilot among 9 victims in Florida plane crash, mother says
candidates.description: U.S. federal officials are investigating after a business jet crashed into a South Florida neighbourhood on Sunday and erupted into a ball of flames, killing all nine people on board and leaving a fiery crater.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian dentist detained by ICE in Minnesota ordered released by federal judge
candidates.description: A Canadian dentist detained by U.S. federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents in Minnesota during a green card interview has been ordered released by a federal judge.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump administration ramps up midterm battles, asks Supreme Court to intervene in California case
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump's Justice Department has shown a willingness to intervene directly in Tuesday's midterm elections, raising fears its law enforcement powers are being used in a partisan manner. The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on Monday to temporarily block California from counting mail-in ballots from 20,000 voters it believes are non-citizens.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Another cyberattack on supermarket fridges sweeps Europe, leaving food spoiled
candidates.description: The incident comes after a very similar cyberattack last month that sent fridge temperatures in some French supermarkets way up. While no one has claimed responsibility for either attack, they have heightened ​concerns among European authorities about hybrid threats to infrastructure, especially in the food system.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: They hate both U.S. parties. They could swing the midterms
candidates.description: In states like Arizona, some undecided voters have grown to dislike both major political parties. Rather than withdrawing altogether, these 'double haters' remain politically engaged and their votes could swing the U.S. midterms.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian bomb attack on aid centre in southern Ukraine kills 26, officials say
candidates.description: Russia bombed an aid distribution centre and neighbouring shelter in southern Ukraine on Monday, killing 26 people, Ukraine's emergency services agency said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Snapchat reaches settlement in case after teens allege platform designed to be addictive
candidates.description: Snapchat parent Snap Inc. has reached a settlement during a trial over claims brought by two teenagers who say the company designed the platform to be addictive, causing their depression, anxiety and eating disorders, attorneys for the plaintiffs said on Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cheap version of HIV-prevention shot raising hope in low-income countries
candidates.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a generic version of the world's only twice-a-year shot to prevent HIV — a big step toward making the drug available inexpensively and more quickly in 120 low- and middle-income countries.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 5 reasons why the Democrats might not take control of Congress in U.S. midterms
candidates.description: Political strategists of both U.S. parties believe it’s almost certain the Democrats will take control of the House of Representatives from the Republicans in Tuesday's midterms. The likelihood of the Democrats flipping the Senate, however, is another story.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. records 1st human bird flu death since last year
candidates.description: A person in Washington state has died from complications of the bird flu, the first such U.S. death in a year.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Poland's in the midst of a constitutional crisis. Here's what's happening
candidates.description: A decade-long dispute in Poland over one of its top courts has come to a head, with the country's prime minister and president at loggerheads, and protests outside the Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw flaring this weekend. Here's why.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian among the dead in Spanish high-speed rail crash
candidates.description: A Canadian was among those killed last week in a high-speed train collision in Toledo, Global Affairs Canada has confirmed.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Economic frustration set to boil over in U.S. midterm elections
candidates.description: The U.S. economy is booming. But as they prepare to vote in Tuesday's midterm elections, American consumers have never been more pessimistic. Economists blame tariffs and the war with Iran.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: King Charles gets drenched in Antigua rainstorm as Camilla gets only umbrella
candidates.description: King Charles flung up his hands in despair as he was caught in a tropical rainstorm in Antigua, while his wife Queen Camilla strolled off with the only available umbrella.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Young men and right-leaning podcasters helped Trump win in 2024. Both have soured on him
candidates.description: Young men are increasingly turned off by U.S. President Donald Trump, and right-leaning podcasters are distancing themselves, too — a trend that experts say could swing House and potential Senate seats in next week's midterms.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: All 9 aboard killed after plane crashes in Florida, officials say
candidates.description: A business jet carrying nine people nosedived into a South Florida neighbourhood on Sunday and erupted into a giant fireball that appeared to just miss homes before crashing near a busy roadway. All passengers on board were killed, U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Despicable betrayal': Democrats stunned after Michigan congresswoman endorses Republican for Senate
candidates.description: Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed's former opponent in the U.S. Senate primary, Haley Stevens, stunned party officials Sunday by endorsing Republican Mike Rogers after Democratic tensions boiled over days before the election that could determine the balance of power on Capitol Hill.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Prince Harry says he wants to reconcile with the Royal Family. It may not be so easy
candidates.description: As much as Prince Harry may signal his desire to reconcile with the Royal Family, making it happen could be a challenge.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: German ministers pledge tough action after rioters damage stores in Frankfurt
candidates.description: German ministers threatened tough penalties for looters and rioters who damaged stores and injured more than 100 police officers in Frankfurt overnight, while still praising public forces for preventing larger-scale violence.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada's next budget to be unveiled this week amid U.S. trade war, economic uncertainty
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney's second budget — set to be unveiled on Thursday — will include new affordability measures, business tax incentives and investments in infrastructure, defence and culture, according to a senior government source.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
candidates.description: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old
candidates.description: In air traffic audio, a crew member can be heard shouting: "We are going to crash into the ground!"
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
candidates.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
candidates.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
candidates.description: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Fake nuclear warning from hacked app sparks unease but not panic in Ukraine
candidates.description: Many Ukrainians, who have faced years of Russian attacks, did not take the messages seriously and doubted their veracity.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Five arrested after South African farmer shot and tortured
candidates.description: The attack on Donovan Marx, 50, comes as right-wing groups say there is a genocide of white people - a claim widely discredited.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
candidates.description: The airline says fuel prices may rise by €2bn in 2028 unless there is an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
candidates.description: There were hundreds of arrests as protesters took to the streets in cities across France for the third weekend in a row.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Popular Australian children's author jailed over child exploitation offences
candidates.description: The author of Jasper Jones and Runt pleaded guilty in May after police raided his home months earlier.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
candidates.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
candidates.description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
candidates.description: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Judge dismisses Trump's lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday book
candidates.description: Trump had sued the media outlet after it published a letter to Epstein purportedly written and signed by the president as part of a birthday book.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Judge orders Trump administration to stop threatening US election officials
candidates.description: The order comes after election officials received letters demanding they set aside the ballots of possible non-citizen voters.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
candidates.description: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
candidates.description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What we know about the alert app hack in Ukraine and Russia
candidates.description: Both Ukraine and Russia say their air raid alert apps were cyber-attacked - Joe Tidy explains what we know so far.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
candidates.description: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What are Americans voting for in this election?
candidates.description: The BBC's Maddie Gerber explains what's on the ballot in the 2026 midterm elections in the United States.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: US midterms campaign 'shattering' spending records to be most expensive ever
candidates.description: The 2026 campaign is projected to cost nearly $12bn - BBC Verify looks into where all that money has come from.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Oil tank vandalism results in waterfowl park 'nightmare'
candidates.description: The popular attraction in County Down has been forced to close while efforts continue to remove oil from the pond.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'Rok' solid recognition for Slovenian space scientist
candidates.description: Two men from the Armagh Planetarium and Observatory have had asteroids named in their honour in recognition of their work.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Aquarium shark that helped 'dispel myths' dies
candidates.description: Staff at Plymouth's aquarium pay tribute to a sand tiger shark believed to be almost 30 years old.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Do the Shetland Isles need Cold War-style military protection?
candidates.description: Calls are being made for the defence of the Shetland Isles to be strengthened after increased sightings of Russian trawlers off the coast of Scotland.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
candidates.description: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
candidates.description: The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
candidates.description: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: This legendary board game could take decades to complete
candidates.description: Andy Taeger & James Purcell are trying to become the first people ever complete the board game Campaign for North Africa. The is so complex it could take decades to finish.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
candidates.description: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: They signed up for a lifetime at sea on an endless cruise. High gas prices intervened
candidates.description: A cruise ship suspended operations suddenly, citing soaring fuel costs. Passengers, including Randy Cassingham, had to disembark in Cambodia. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Cassingham about the ordeal.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
candidates.description: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
candidates.description: Saying the president was "grasping at straws," a federal judge on Saturday threw out Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
candidates.description: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
candidates.description: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Has Trump kept his promises to the MAHA movement?
candidates.description: It's been just over two years since the rise of Make America Healthy Again, or MAHA. How well is the Trump administration meeting its promises?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: It's ACA open enrollment time. Here are the changes for health insurance shoppers
candidates.description: The ACA health insurance marketplaces — find yours at HealthCare.gov — open Nov. 1 for 2027 coverage. Getting an early start may be especially important this year.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: How one family gave a critical boost to gene therapy research
candidates.description: A family affected by Sanfilippo syndrome raised millions of dollars for research. The Food and Drug Administration just approved a gene therapy the support helped make possible.
candidates.author: NPR
